'''Winter''' can refer to the following:

* ''[[Winter's Heart]]'' - the ninth book of ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series.
* ''[[The Eye of the World/Chapter 5|Winternight]]'' - the fifth chapter of ''[[The Eye of the World]]''.
* ''[[Winter's Heart/Chapter 12|A Lily in Winter]]'' - the twelfth chapter of ''Winter's Heart''.
* [[The Winter Blossom]] - an [[inn]] in [[Ebou Dar]].
* [[Winter Dawn]] - a [[wolf]] known to [[Perrin Aybara]].
* [[Winterfinch]] - a [[horse]] owned by [[Beonin Marinye]].
* [[Great Winter War]] - a conflict between [[Andor]] and [[Cairhien]] in {{ne|671}}.
* [[Winternight]] - a holiday marking the last day of winter.
